An Ambassador opens Main Menu,… The whole instructions are under Documents to work from.

versions.label: Version 2
versions.status: Current: I added an "Add your CPL Assistant email" section after the User Module steps. It gives the four steps from Sam's instructions, explains what the email does for students' Request CPL Review, notes that a college needs both this email and a CPL Coordinator to qualify automatically, and links the training video. I also added one clause to the lede naming the new section; no Save step appears because neither source mentions one. I placed Picture 14 and left out Pictures 11, 12 and 13, which repeat it, and Pictures 15 to 17, which show the Student Contact checkbox the request did not ask for. Pictures 14 (an email address), 4 (names and email addresses) and 5 (a name and email address) show personal details, so the team should cover or crop them before publishing. Drafted from the card by Sam (draft 0869bdeb-b6c4-4533-8840-ee2b50bc688a); replaced the public copy on Sam's approval.
